title: Kofi prologue — room and object references

rooms.title: Tsalohi at evening
rooms.description: A compact timber-and-stone square on the eastern brink of the Rift. Worn stone foundations, patched pale plaster and ochre woven awnings frame a shared cooking place. The far chasm reads behind the square, not as a path the player can enter. A repaired pen occupies the left, communal work occupies the middle, and the chicken coop and inland gate sit to the right. Keep the gate silhouette clear against trees inland. Dusk is warm but evenly painted; the disaster uses separate ground, building and ledge layers over the same background.
rooms.background: Distant Rift cliffs, sky, inland treeline and remote stone outcrops only. Leave the entire near square, building strip, work areas and ground plain behind removable layers. No gate, fire, coop, trestle, bell, tools, people, animals or collapse cracks in the background.

stages.description: Ordinary errands; all neighbours alive; gate pin and bell change during chores.

Intact ground hides; central footing and two ledges show. Both candidates visible until the explicit choice. Hide the unsaved ledge and its actor together; the survivor crosses the footing.
Hide collapsing near buildings, ground and props with their supporting ledge; keep inland gate and stable exit readable until the fade.

exits.label: Inland trail
exits.description: Right edge. Initially blocked by dialogue; after rescue it is the scripted escape. No left-edge Rift exit.

notes: Reserve approach feet (160,650) for the pen, (430,650) for the pot, (690,650) for Deyu and (1040,650) for the coop. During rescue, the ordinary floor route is suspended; central footing and reachable ledge edges are staging references, not permission to walk across the chasm.

Evening: Oweli at (940,620), Saluna at (850,620), Ahyeli at (1110,620), Tali and Kanu in the adjacent (1070..1150,610) zone, Huska at (1180,620); goats within pen x=70..230, chickens by coop x=1000..1100. These are independently rendered actors. Rescue: Enali’s pinned actor occupies the left ledge under trestle, Deyu hangs from the right rail; Oweli and families are already inland. Huska waits behind Kofi on the stable central footing. Only the explicit rescue changes which human actor exits alive.

rooms.title: Trail camp at night
rooms.description: A low clearing enclosed by close, dark trunks. The trail enters at the left and continues right, but neither edge suggests an extra explorable area tonight. The fire is left of centre, possessions and chicken baskets shelter farther left, and the herd waits at the right-hand edge before Huska gathers it inward. Leave the right third comparatively empty for the wolf encounter and the later last-wolf decision. A few bedrolls tuck against the back line; none crosses the main walking lane.
rooms.background: Trunks, distant dark foliage, level earth and fixed stones outside interaction areas. No fire, loose branch, bedding, baskets, bundles, carried vessels, animals or people painted into the room. Leave clean backing beneath the separate dead bough and removable caught fire stick; never bake either into the trees.

stages.description: The quiet bow exchange introduces Deyu’s folding bow, hunting points, reusable wooden blunt arrow and cord-carrying arrows. The fire stick starts caught in a separate dead bough; only the chosen human survivor is present.
The blunt arrow has knocked down the loose fire stick and been recovered. The stick lies separately on clean ground until taken; the bare dead bough stays in place.
Branch removed from ground and lit in Kofi’s hand; goats gathered inside the light. Both preparations required for encounter.
Wolf pack has fled; the last wolf is an actor at the right. Kill occurs out of view, or the actor exits. No trophy or carcass prop.
Same objects and actor identities; runtime lighting changes. Packing hides them only as their carriers leave.

Moonlight is steady; fire flicker and light pools belong to runtime effects. The carried trough is visible beside the communal kit; its selected-survivor form is not a camp puzzle.

Ahyeli and sleeping children occupy the rear mat zone (600..730,568), Oweli at (500,620). Place exactly one survivor at (440,620). Herd starts near (1090,620), gathers to (810..910,620); Huska moves between these zones. Wolves approach through x=1030..1200 and leave through the right cover; the last wolf is an actor, not a new object image. Both aftermath choices leave the same kit visible.

The dead bough is at (980,350) art px over an empty landing patch, away from sleepers and animals. Its loose fire stick drops to (540,610) after the wooden blunt arrow shot. The bow demonstration is staging only; no new actor art is requested. Both utility arrows are recovered; neither creates a specialised metal head.

rooms.title: Riverbank / Amaneti
rooms.description: A broad bank seen as a readable stage: water and reeds at the left rear, a small upper seep over stone farther inland, an ochre clay face near the middle, and dry building ground to the right. The washing point is downstream from the collection point. Small shade trees border the top of frame; the very tall tree and tree huts belong to the woodland clearing, not here. Keep a long, level walking lane along the front. Houses and gardens grow behind that lane, leaving all water stations accessible.
rooms.background: Distant river channel, far bank, noninteractive shade trees, bare dry ground and plain stone backing for the seep. Interactive water surfaces, reeds, clay cut, footprints, leaves and all settlement objects are separate overlays.

rooms.title: Woodland clearing
rooms.description: A sunny pocket above the riverbank. The bank path reaches the lower-left edge; the river is a silver glimpse between distant trunks. A naturally fallen tree and loose bark lie to the left, a work board sits left of centre, and a very tall living tree rises right of centre. Its broad roots frame a clear beam-lift area and a visible fork high above hand reach. To the right, a trail disappears into deeper forest. Later, two tree huts occupy the same tall tree and a small roofed watch post sits by the forest boundary.
rooms.background: Distant woodland, river glimpse, rooted earth and the noninteractive trunk structure. Leave clean background behind bark, beams, branch target, platform areas, ladders, huts, watch post and the foreground canopy cut.

stages.description: Loose bark, board, timber, cradle and branch target. No ladder or finished platform yet.
Light cord replaced by load rope; beam and cradle rise only with agreed helpers.
Secured low platform, ladder and first tree hut. Loose dead branch collectible once for offering.
Two tree huts, second ladder, shared refuge and watch post. Watch board and hand-rope state changes active.
Agreements persist; forest trail open only after Kofi collects travel kit at bank.

notes: Main walk lane y=636..690 remains clear. Target branch and elevated platform are reached by a staged action from (820,650), never by scaling actors smaller. Ladder practice uses existing character references; no new pose artwork is commissioned by this pack. The ground below the arrow landing point (1000,620) stays empty of actors during the shot.

Most visits begin with Kofi alone. Saluna arrives briefly on first entry then returns to bank. For beam lift only, Saluna and Tohani move up from the bank and use the marked helper feet. For practice only, Ahyeli, Tali, Kanu and Saluna come up together, using the family ladder rather than refuge ladder. Their names identify staging, not new pose/design requests. Common-stage cup overlay in the sheet illustrates Deyu’s memorial placement; Enali’s alternate cup destination is specified in the cup brief.

rooms.title: Deep forest
rooms.description: Older, closer trees narrow the view. The path returns left toward Amaneti, passes the near face of a fallen log, and bends toward dense cover at the right. Fresh tracks and torn brush warn of a large animal before it appears. A dead side limb tied down by a rotten vine blocks room to back away. Clearing that limb exposes an open strip in front of the log, while the log itself remains. Leave the right half open enough to read the bear silhouette and charge without hiding Kofi.

rooms.title: Kofi’s hut
rooms.description: A small round ground hut represented as a flat, intimate interior, with no forced side-wall perspective. Woven reed walls and clay daub show repairs. A doorway at the left holds the travel rack. The bedroll lies left of centre; a cold hearth and low arrow shelf occupy the middle; drying nets, a shifted beam and its stone sill occupy the right. A stool gives the freed creature a hiding place. Steady moonlight makes objects readable without revealing the body trapped in the nets.
rooms.background: Plain reed-and-clay back wall, roof interior and level floor. Keep clean patches beneath rack, tools, shelf, arrows, hearth, gap, net, beam, sill, stool and bedroll. No eyes or creature silhouette in background or net painting.

stages.description: Travel kit stowed; beam pins tangled net. Pole and wedge by cold hearth; arrow on shelf.
Lever raises beam; can safely lower again until wedge inserted. No timed interaction.
Wedge supports beam; loose drawcord can be unpicked.
Net slack then folded clear; beam stays supported; robot actor emerges and may hide under stool.
One shelf arrow lies under hearth edge, then in front of robot, then is picked up.
Arrow returned to shelf; pole returned to tool spot; wedge remains structurally installed; bedroll corner clear for robot.

exits.description: Left doorway; closing scene stays here until arrow shelved and robot settled.

notes: Accessible action feet: (300,650) bedroll, (650,650) hearth, (880,650) beam/net, (1080,650) stool. Layer net in front of trapped actor; remove masking only at reveal. Beam occupies rear upper space and never blocks the walking lane. Robot and Kofi are staging references, not assets commissioned here.

Robot eyes behind the net are a masked actor reference, never painted in net or room. After freeing, the actor may move under stool at (1070,600), into the dry gap reach zone (720,620), then beside bedroll (400,600). Front stool legs occlude only the hiding actor. Kofi’s invitation/withdrawal does not transform the robot into a prop. Huska stays outside; no dog silhouette is painted into doorway.

rules: Story and puzzle intent live in the linked STORY.md scenes; this specification owns visual facts, target classification, source references, placements, stages and attachments. Generated references are never edited directly.

Finished-art planning only: runtime logic now exists in src/chapters/kofi1 with separate simple placeholders. Reference regeneration does not import assets, install either Kofi rig or generate finished game art.
The six locations appear in story order. The woodland clearing contains timber work, tree huts and watch shelter; ground huts, gardens and the rite remain on the riverbank.

Exactly one of Enali and Deyu survives after the explicit rescue. Enali route assembles the trough; Deyu route begins with assembled trough and fitted screen. All common stages retain the chosen human survivor.
Each human-survivor route supports all four kill/release combinations for last wolf and bear: eight complete narrative paths. No corpse, trophy or extra resource reward is commissioned.
A source pickup, carried item and installed representation are one identity. Hide the old representation when it moves. Dedicated later supplies are not resurrected Tsalohi objects.
Structural geometry and foreground cuts have no automatic Look action. Targets are the existing story-defined inspections and puzzle uses; actor dialogue targets remain character staging references.
Alternate state drawings share dimensions and anchors. Hide means no empty PNG. Semantic-only changes reuse existing drawings. Inventory icons are 64x64 and include only carried forms.
World coordinates use 1280x720 art pixels; divide by two for logical units. Keep the approved palette and two-pixel world grid. Runtime controls text and lighting; moonlight is steady.

Use labelled stage controls for illustrative snapshots; All overlays shows alternative footprints, not a simultaneous scene. Per-action visibility conditions remain in each asset and placement record.
The hut support wedge remains installed under the beam at the ending. Only the loose pole returns beside the hearth.
The 224-art-pixel Kofi scale is a planning reference only. Existing character/animal designs and poses are excluded from this pack; no new portraits, combat images or cards.
The original pre-alignment pack is preserved in before-alignment.zip for recovery only, not as an editable authority.

Deyu made Kofi’s original folding bow. Basic hunting arrows, a plain wooden blunt arrow and a light-cord arrow exist in the prologue; later engineered forked/weighted/cutting heads belong to Nessa’s rebuild. Camp blunt shot and clearing cord shot preserve arrow identity and require an unfolded bow.
